ideas.title: Minnesota Medicaid Overhaul: A Path to Reduced Fraud?
ideas.description: Investigate the proposed elimination of Managed Care Organizations in Minnesota's Medicaid system and its potential impact on fraud reduction.
ideas.angle: Analyzing the potential effects of the overhaul on Medicaid fraud
questions: Will the overhaul reduce Medicaid fraud?
What are the challenges in implementing the changes?
ideas.insight: The proposed changes could significantly impact Medicaid service delivery and potentially reduce fraud, but also pose challenges for beneficiaries and the state.

ideas.title: Feeding Our Future Fraud Trial: Causes and Consequences of Delays
ideas.description: Examine the impact of federal prosecutor staffing issues on the Feeding Our Future fraud trial and the recovery of potentially fraudulent funds.
ideas.angle: Investigating the causes and consequences of trial delays
questions: How will trial delays affect the recovery of fraudulent funds?
What are the implications for those involved in the alleged fraud?
ideas.insight: The delays in the trial could have significant consequences for the recovery of potentially fraudulent funds and the prosecution of those involved.
